premise: Butterfly lands on Fox's head — AH-CHOO! — Fox's sneeze blows her onto Mushroom's cap, her wings tickle Mushroom — ACHOO! — the glitter lands on Hedgehog's nose — tishoo! — and when the sneeze comes back round to Fox, it comes out as a giggle.
inspiration: This Is the House That Jack Built and For Want of a Nail (cumulative folk chains), turned into a sneeze that travels round and ends as a laugh.
lesson: A giggle spreads just as easily as a sneeze.

en-US.title: The Sneeze That Went Round
en-US.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Mushroom was standing quietly in the meadow, and {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying up {hedgehog:go to mushroom} to doze beside her. {hedgehog:face sleeping} All was calm. Then along trotted {fox:enter} Fox, and {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered down {butterfly:go on fox} right on top of his head. Tickle, tickle. {fox:face surprised} Ah… ah… {sfx:big-sneeze} AH-CHOO! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] Whoosh! The sneeze blew Butterfly {butterfly:go on mushroom} onto Mushroom's cap. {butterfly:live} She folded her wings, then fluttered them. Tickle, tickle. {mushroom:live hold} Ah… ah… [pause] {mushroom:live resume} {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! Up puffed some glitter, and down it floated… onto Hedgehog's nose. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live} Hedgehog curled up in a ball, then peeked out and sniffed. Ah… ah… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} {hedgehog:wobble} tishoo! His tiny sneeze floated all the way over to Fox's nose. Ah… ah… [pause] Everyone waited. {all:face surprised} But instead of sneezing… Fox {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} giggled. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} And that giggle went all the way round the meadow.

es-ES.title: El estornudo que dio la vuelta
es-ES.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Seta estaba tan tranquila en el prado, y {hedgehog:enter} Erizo llegó correteando {hedgehog:go to mushroom} a echar una cabezadita a su lado. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Todo estaba en calma. Entonces llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro, y {butterfly:enter} Mariposa bajó revoloteando {butterfly:go on fox} y se le posó en la cabeza. Cosquillas, cosquillas. {fox:face surprised} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:big-sneeze} ¡AAACHÍS! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] ¡Fiuuu! El estornudo mandó a Mariposa {butterfly:go on mushroom} al sombrero de Seta. {butterfly:live} Plegó las alas, y luego las agitó. Cosquillas, cosquillas. {mushroom:live hold} Aaa… aaa… [pause] {mushroom:live resume} {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! Subió un soplo de purpurina, y bajó flotando… hasta la nariz de Erizo. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live} Erizo se hizo una bola, luego asomó y olisqueó. Aaa… aaa… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} {hedgehog:wobble} ¡chis! Su estornudito cruzó el prado flotando… hasta la nariz de Zorro. Aaa… aaa… [pause] Todos esperaron. {all:face surprised} Pero en vez de estornudar… Zorro {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} se echó a reír. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} Y la risa dio la vuelta a todo el prado.
